verdict.rationale: Letta's docs confirm a published pricing page with a free BYOK tier (letta-docs-56), a capped free stateful-agent tier (letta-docs-36) and a usage-based developer plan (letta-docs-49), which addresses the free-tier and general cost-model part of the story. However, no explicit per-unit rate table (e.g., $/agent-hour, $/GB memory, $/token) is shown in the evidence, so a platform engineer cannot precisely project memory costs. Missing for 10: concrete per-unit pricing figures/rate card, and independent confirmation of actual billing granularity for memory usage.
